verzen.tekst: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verzen.html: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

voetnoten.tekst: When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “ יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

verzen.tekst: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,
verzen.html: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

verzen.tekst: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
verzen.html: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

verzen.tekst: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
verzen.html: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

verzen.tekst: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you:
verzen.html: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you:

verzen.tekst: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

verzen.tekst: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

verzen.tekst: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verzen.tekst: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them amongst the children of Israel;
verzen.html: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them amongst the children of Israel;

verzen.tekst: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
verzen.html: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

verzen.tekst: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
verzen.html: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

verzen.tekst: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
verzen.html: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

verzen.tekst: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
